title: Batch OCR Testing
description: Select a folder containing multiple PDF/PNG files and run OCR tests on all of them at once. Ground truth files with matching names will be automatically detected.

howItWorks.title: How it works:
howItWorks.step1: Select a folder containing PDF/PNG files
howItWorks.step2: Ground truth files (matching filenames with .txt extension) are automatically detected
howItWorks.step3: For files without ground truth, you can select a text file or skip that file
howItWorks.step4: Select OCR processors to test on all files
howItWorks.step5: Review the batch HTML report with results for all files
